name: starter-app
description: Template for a new app. Rename it before you build anything.

requiredTables.name: items
requiredTables.description: Example table. Replace it with your app's tables.

requestedGrants.reason: Who may open the app. Which group is decided by the grant in the control plane — a requested permission is a request, not a grant.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Connection to the app's own schema, with the app role. Set by the control plane.

env.name: DATABASE_SCHEMA
env.description: The app's own schema. The SDK derives the search_path from it; a DSN with options= is rejected.

env.name: OPENAPPS_AUTH_SECRET
env.description: The app's own secret, used by the SDK to verify the gateway signature. Set by the control plane per deployment.

env.name: OPENAPPS_APP_ID
env.description: Id of this app in the signature material. Must be byte-identical to what the gateway writes.

env.name: OPENAPPS_APP_HOST
env.description: Shared domain in the signature material, trimmed and lowercased.

env.name: OPENAPPS_APP_BASE_PATH
env.description: Path the app lives under (e.g. /starter-app). Must be set at build time, otherwise links and images point nowhere.
